screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_aura.label: Aura style
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_aura.sparki: Aura style (press to change): Sparking. A blaze of quick flame tongues that touch the body, lick up past the head and fade, with little electric sparks crackling in it. Base and Supers 1-3 always burn Sparking; Primal Super always burns Smooth; Super Primal Super burns Godly, or Smooth if picked; your pick shows in every other form.
screen.jaymospowers.zfighter_aura.smooth: Aura style (press to change): Smooth. Short, wide, slow wisps close to the body, a soft wavering glow round your outline, with motes drifting up. Base and Supers 1-3 always burn Sparking; Primal Super always burns Smooth; Super Primal Super burns Godly, or Smooth if picked; your pick shows in every other form.
Aura style (press to change): Godly. Tall, thin, pale strands that hug the body and peel off slowly, with tiny motes drifting up. Base and Supers 1-3 always burn Sparking; Primal Super always burns Smooth; Super Primal Super burns Godly, or Smooth if picked; your pick shows in every other form.
